timeline_action.0-3s: From frame 0 the Triceratops is already galloping along the path and the tyrannosaur is already running about thirty meters behind in the left half of the frame, head low and forward, tail straight out. Each of the tyrannosaur's huge feet plants in the mud and throws a spray of mud behind it before the next foot lifts. Nora speaks immediately from second 0, off-screen.
timeline_action.3-7s: The tyrannosaur closes to about twelve meters, its head growing larger in the left half of the frame. From about 3.5 to 5 seconds it lifts its head and opens its jaws wide in one long roar while Nora goes silent and gasps; its jaws close again by 5 seconds. Then Nora speaks again. The Triceratops leans and swerves toward the right, so the whole view tilts a little to the right and the path behind them swings toward the left of the frame.
timeline_action.7-10s: The Triceratops gallops between the two massive trunks: they slide into the frame from the left and right edges, pass on both sides and then recede behind. The tyrannosaur reaches the gap, plants both feet and skids in the mud, its body lurching forward past its feet and its tail swinging up as a counterweight before it settles to a stop between the trunks, too wide to fit through. By about 9 seconds it stands still behind the trunks, chest heaving, turning its head slowly from side to side over about one second, no sudden snap. Nora finishes her line by about 9 seconds; the last half second is the view bouncing away from the stopped tyrannosaur.
